title: Kim Agent IPC Events
description: All typed events emitted from Python orchestrator → Rust subprocess.rs → Tauri → React. Edit this file and run 'npm run gen:events' to regenerate events.gen.ts.

events.description: A human-readable status message from the agent loop (activity feed item).

message.description: Status text to display in activity feed.

events.description: Agent emitted a structured plan with step list.
Agent advanced to a new plan step.

cumulative_input.description: Total input tokens consumed so far.

phase.description: Budget phase label (ok / warn / critical / full).

last_input.description: Input tokens in the last provider call.

last_output.description: Output tokens in the last provider call.

source.description: Provider identifier that produced this snapshot.

estimate.description: True when token count is estimated rather than exact.

events.description: Cumulative token usage for this run.
Window/UI control signal from the agent.

action.description: 'screenshot_flash' triggers flash overlay; 'show' brings main window to front.

termination.description: Termination reason key: task_complete | max_iterations | stuck | provider_failed | need_help | cancelled | conversational_loop.

events.description: Run ended due to a recoverable or unrecoverable error.

recoverable.description: True when the user can retry without config changes.

events.description: Provider call failed with a specific error code.

code.description: Error code: auth | rate_limit | server_error | timeout | network | invalid_request.

retryable.description: True when automatic retry is possible.

events.description: Provider rate-limited; agent will retry after a delay.
Agent is requesting human approval before executing a high-risk tool.

risk.description: Risk level: high | medium. Determines UI prominence.

preview.description: K6: human-readable preview — command string, unified diff (<=40 lines), or URL + element label. May be empty.

events.description: Human approval decision sent back to the agent.

tool.description: MCP tool name that was approved or denied.

approved.description: True if the user approved the tool call.
